fields.description: Issue includes editorials and satirical coverage of the Shriners' convention in Miami and the concurrent presence of federal prohibition agents, emphasizing impacts on local business, nightlife, and liquor enforcement. Reports and commentary address Miami police department controversy involving Chief of Police Leslie Quigg, including discussion of indictments, acquittal, and related violence. Political content includes extensive local and state election notes and multiple paid announcements for judicial and other offices (e.g., Civil Court of Record). Additional local-interest items include traffic-safety concerns at a specific intersection, letters to the editor (including on the "Rose Mahoney" vessel), and advertisements for Miami-area businesses and services.
